# Testing

Run the full check before calling a change done:
- Build: `./gradlew build`
- Test: `./gradlew test`

## Unit & integration tests: kotlin toolchain
- Run: `./gradlew test`
- Write the failing test first, then the code. Place tests where the toolchain convention puts them.
